findings.claim: 344 returns the superseded receipt under `reversed` for a reversal while the route required `corrected`, so every committed reversal would have been reported as uncertain (500); the route test hand-built the reply and could not see it
findings.disposition: Fixed: the contract §3.3 settles the reversal reply as { receipt, reversed, occurrence, verification_superseded_receipt_id, replayed } (no issue key); the guard, route and tests use `reversed`; the probe pins the exact key sets of both replies so a rename fails the replay.
Fixed and tested (uuid, null, absent → null).

findings.claim: a correction that omitted performed_at defaulted to the correction instant, which the chain-root bound refuses after two minutes and which silently moved the occurrence's performed time inside that window (verified with a two-minute sleep experiment)
findings.disposition: Fixed: the shared statement helper takes a default instant; record passes the server clock, correct passes the corrected receipt's performed_at; probe cases: omitted performed_at preserves the original instant and sla_met, the inherited instant is judged by the late rule, an explicit later instant is refused (22023).

findings.claim: the amended 343 requires md5 in every object-kind prepare payload and verifies it against the Storage eTag, so the COL-145 probe (no md5, eTag 'etag-<id>') stopped the native replay at prepare and its fixture uploads could never finalize
findings.disposition: Fixed: probe obj() and put() helpers mirror the 343 probe (declared md5, quoted MD5 eTag, version); race script declares md5 and writes the same eTag; col145_base344 rebuilt at 45ea4ea9; replay PASS (347 files, 28 probes); probe 176 assertions.

findings.claim: the EXISTS that pairs a deferred superseded pointer with the inserted correction never matched when the inserted row had no corrects_receipt_id, so under the owner token with the FK deferred a plain recording could absorb the pointer
findings.disposition: Fixed: NEW.corrects_receipt_id IS NOT NULL is required before any row may point at NEW.id; probe DO block under the token proves the refusal (Supersession stays within one act of work) and that nothing sticks.

findings.claim: under the token only same-occurrence was checked, not that the superseder corrects this receipt or the reviewed receipt; no reachable path, but procedural rather than structural
findings.disposition: Tightened: a performance receipt is superseded only by the correction or reversal that names it in its own chain; a review only by the existing correction or reversal of the receipt it reviewed; three refusal probes added.
